sources.evidence: Nature Materials 2025 shallow single-divacancy quantum sensor at room temperature; ~13 nT/sqrt(Hz projected for isotope-engineered material and ~56 nT/sqrt(Hz anticipated from observed non-optimized shallow-center parameters.
sources.benchmark_warning: Sensitivity values are model-derived/anticipated from measured parameters and are not automatically comparable with a differently configured diamond sensor.

sources.evidence: Nature Communications 2025 shallow-NV interface engineering; calculated AC sensitivity improves from ~50 to 23 nT/sqrt(Hz using recorded parameters, with CPMG-enhanced coherence above 1 ms and a reported calculated 16 nT/sqrt(Hz under CPMG-64.
sources.benchmark_warning: The sensitivity analysis uses an echo/AC protocol and differs from the SiC qNMR/pulsed-ESR context; exact depth/frequency/task matching is required.

sources.evidence: Diamond and Related Materials 2025 portable NV ensemble magnetometer; directly measured mean 0.3 +/- 0.2 nT/sqrt(Hz in non-vector mode over 10-150 Hz.
sources.benchmark_warning: This is an ensemble portable device and cannot be used as an apples-to-apples winner against a single-defect SiC number.

sources.evidence: Nature Communications 2025 coherent photoelectrical single-spin readout at room temperature; PDMR single-spin SNR was 1.7-2.0 times the optimized optical readout for two measured defects.
sources.benchmark_warning: This establishes a within-SiC readout comparison, not a cross-host magnetic-sensitivity or end-to-end cost winner.

sources.evidence: Nature Communications 2025 ambient single-NV surface-voltage detected coherent dynamics using KPFM; single spin at ~7 nm depth, with signal response on the order of 10 ms.
sources.benchmark_warning: Different electrical-readout physics and response-time boundary from SiC PDMR; no matched cross-host resource/cost comparison is established.

sources.evidence: npj Nanophotonics 2026 waveguide-integrated SiC V2 color centers; >100 kcps standard PLE, ~125 kcps with charge-resonance check, theoretical >98% single-shot readout fidelity at cryogenic conditions.
sources.benchmark_warning: Cryogenic photonic integration is valuable device evidence but cannot be mixed with room-temperature sensing metrics without environmental-resource accounting.

sources.evidence: NIST overview notes room-temperature NV coherence up to milliseconds in carefully prepared diamond and field detectivities on the order of 1 nT/sqrt(Hz.
sources.benchmark_warning: Overview-scale reference; use primary matched experiments for winner claims.

research_attribution.ai_contribution: primary-source literature verification, apples-to-apples benchmark sufficiency design, evidence classification and provenance capture
